exposure: Hearing status (deaf or hard of hearing vs. non-deaf or hard of hearing)
outcome: Pregnancy complications (pre-existing diabetes, gestational diabetes, pre-eclampsia and eclampsia, placental abruption)
cohort: Women with singleton deliveries who gave birth in Massachusetts between January 1998 and December 2013.
finding: Deaf or hard of hearing women had an increased risk of chronic medical conditions, pregnancy complications, and adverse birth outcomes, including preterm birth, low birth weight, and low Apgar scores.
birth_weight: Measured as an outcome (low birth weight or very low weight)
